measurementMethod: Approximate visual landmark measurements from the source artwork, not surveyed dimensions. Canonical editable data is in shared/template-scenes/*.json.

melayu-balairung.notes: Approximate art measurements, railing is primary; ambiguous stair is secondary. Weighted median; no fixed character screen height.
